quote.text: Volume negates luck. 27 leads and 0 closes isn't a lead problem, it's a follow-up problem. The money is in the reps you haven't done yet.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls booked. Check GHL/Calendly for any weekend bookings, then run a full personal follow-up pass on every unbooked lead. Monday inbound is light — turn it into an outbound day and book the first call.
focus: Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at ~$17 CPL — that's $460+ spent on people who never booked, and zero prospect replies in the last 48 hours. Run a personal text-and-call blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link. Lead volume is fine; the only lever left is follow-up speed and reps.

Confirm today's FB ad is delivering at ~$35/day and that the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 groups. With no closes yet you can't afford a silent delivery failure quietly burning budget, and the group posts are your only free top-of-funnel while outbound is paused.

Instantly billing has lapsed and LinkedIn is paused, so paid FB Ads are your only live channel for a business with zero revenue. Reactivate one outbound lever today — either restart Instantly or send 20 manual DMs to home-service owners. One channel can't carry the whole pipeline.
